references.title: A 2.8 fJ/conversion-step 10-bit 500 kS/s SAR ADC with low-power switching scheme and dynamic comparator
references.adopted: Separate acquisition/reset, conversion, VDD and reference-source signed energy; no omitted reset-energy claim.
references.not_reproduced: Differential switching topology, bootstrap/double-tail comparator or published energy, ENOB and capacitor reduction. Existing single-ended SKY130 ADC is preserved.

references.title: Clock-Gating Insertion Strategies on an Open-Source MSP430 Core: A Reproducible PPA Study and a Gate-Level Simulation Caveat
references.authors: Xingran Huang; Qiming Guo; Jinwen Tang; Wenqi Jia; Dongzheng Wang
references.venue: arXiv preprint v1; authors report acceptance at IEEE UEMCON 2026
references.read_scope: Full HTML, sections IV-B–D and V-G
references.technology: openMSP430, commercial 32 nm synthesis flow; not this accumulator CPU
references.adopted: Keep RTL/gate/CMOS replay and transistor timing as distinct evidence; explicitly report unavailable clock-gating/STA closure.
references.not_reproduced: ICG insertion, MSP430 architecture, SDF/STA closure or reported PPA savings.

references.title: ISSCC 2026 Press Kit — Analog, Power Management, Data Converters and Frequency Synthesizers trends
references.venue: Official conference summaries; not full research papers
references.read_scope: PDF pages 97–98 and 113–122 (zero-based), including paper 32.2 summary
references.technology: Multiple technologies; architecture and robustness trends only
references.adopted: PVT/source-buffer assumptions, source completeness and named noise/linearity/timing gaps on every block.
